title: Fall 2026 Tryouts
body:
Esports at UCF will be hosting tryouts for all of our 10 titles for the Fall 2026 semester!

Apex Legends, Overwatch, Splatoon, Rainbow Six Siege, Marvel Rivals, CounterStrike 2, Rocket League, Smash Ultimate, Valorant, and League of Legends.
imageAlt: Graphic for the Esports at UCF tryouts. Shows characters from multiple game genres and the date for signups, sep 4th-6th 7pm EST.

title: Valorant Student Series
body:
